answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh nectar challenge every epoch. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the relic of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. So a jade of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 15zuu.
